description: E21's rover routes for the Earth link (B-40: lunarsim.rover.expert.plan(terrain, a, b, None), the slope-only route) against the night routes of the driving tables and data/driving/routes-v1.json (plan(..., 'night')). Both are optimal and equally long; they differ in which of several equal-cost paths A* returns.
cause: the night cost grid multiplies every cell cost by 1/SHADOW_SPEED_FACTOR while the A* heuristic (straight-line distance x 1 s/m) stays unscaled, so the search breaks ties between equal-cost paths differently

geometry.metric: symmetric Hausdorff distance (m) between the two polylines, each resampled at 1 m

linked_share.definition: share of the hours 2028-2031 in which every 100 m route sample of the leg sees Earth (direct, any part of the disc, hourly samples of earth_link-v2-samples.json.gz)
